title: System updates
description: Check for new releases and update this installation.
multiDescription: Updates affect every company on this installation. Only operators can run them.
unavailable: Updates from this screen have not been configured on this server. Ask the installation administrator to enable the update service.
noRelease: No stable release has been published yet.
notChecked: Check whether a new stable version is available.
upToDate: This installation is already running the available version or a newer one.
reconnecting: The system is restarting. This screen will resume tracking automatically. You do not need to confirm again.
actionFailed: The request could not be completed. Check the update status before trying again.
statusFailed: Could not read the update status. We will retry automatically.
confirmSingle: The system will be temporarily unavailable. The update service will back up the database, local files and configuration before installing the prepared release. If the update fails after changing the database, recovery will require restoring this backup.
confirmMulti: Every company will be temporarily unavailable. The update service will back up the control database, every company database, local files and configuration before updating. If the update fails after changing the database, recovery will require restoring this backup.

phases.preparing: Downloading and verifying the new version…
phases.prepared: Version prepared. Confirm when you are ready to update.
phases.installing: Installing the version and restarting the system…
phases.failed: The update did not complete. The previous version was kept.
phases.recovery_required: The server administrator needs to recover this installation.

messages.updater_interrupted: The update service was interrupted. Check the backup and installation state before continuing.
messages.restore_backup_required: The new version failed verification. Services were stopped to preserve data. The server administrator must restore the backup recorded for this update.
messages.restart_failed: Could not restart the previous version. Ask the server administrator to check the services.
messages.insufficient_disk: There is not enough space for the image and backups. Free disk space and try again.
messages.preparation_failed: Could not download or verify the image. Check registry access on the server.
messages.backup_failed: The backup did not complete. The new version was not installed.
messages.invalid_image: The image does not match the requested official release.
messages.invalid_version: The received version is not a valid stable release.
messages.invalid_databases: Could not verify the databases to back up.
messages.unsupported_storage_mount: The update service requires a Docker volume for local storage. Ask the server administrator to review the configuration.
messages.version_mismatch: The running version does not match the prepared release.
